import hashlib, json, re
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urljoin, urlsplit

base = 'https://canadabuys.canada.ca/en/tender-opportunities'
root = Path('products/services/canadian-small-rfq-data-delivery')
source = root / 'raw/canadabuys-tender-opportunities.html'
raw = source.read_bytes()
digest = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
assert digest == '73183c7745314cd66f100d809439ae17b7e905a5c203745e2a35e8055befd085', 'Capture differs from the successful FETCH receipt'

class Page(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.anchor = None
        self.links = {}
        self.forms = []
        self.fields = []

    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        attr = dict(attrs)
        if tag == 'form':
            self.forms.append({key: attr.get(key) for key in ('method', 'action', 'id')})
        if tag in ('input', 'select') and attr.get('type') != 'hidden' and attr.get('name'):
            self.fields.append({key: attr.get(key) for key in ('name', 'type', 'value', 'placeholder')})
        if tag == 'a' and attr.get('href'):
            self.anchor = (attr['href'], [])

    def handle_data(self, data):
        if self.anchor:
            self.anchor[1].append(data)

    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        if tag != 'a' or self.anchor is None:
            return
        href, text = self.anchor
        self.anchor = None
        url = urlsplit(urljoin(base, href))
        if url.scheme != 'https' or url.netloc != 'canadabuys.canada.ca':
            return
        if not re.fullmatch(r'/(?:en/tender-opportunities/tender-notice|fr/occasions-de-marche/appel-d-offres)/[^/]+/?', url.path):
            return
        label = ' '.join(' '.join(text).split())[:240]
        canonical = url._replace(query='', fragment='').geturl()
        if label and (canonical not in self.links or len(label) > len(self.links[canonical])):
            self.links[canonical] = label

page = Page()
page.feed(raw.decode('utf-8', errors='replace'))
keywords = re.compile(r'\bcsv\b|reconcil|data (?:quality|dictionary|conversion|cleansing|migration)|dictionnaire de donn|qualit.{0,3} des donn', re.I)
links = [{'url': url, 'label': label, 'keyword_hit': bool(keywords.search(label))} for url, label in page.links.items()]
links.sort(key=lambda link: not link['keyword_hit'])
result = {'source': base, 'receipt': 'TASK-179527536100', 'sha256': digest, 'search_filter_verified': False, 'forms': page.forms[:12], 'visible_fields': page.fields[:30], 'notice_links_found': len(links), 'notice_links': links[:30], 'limits': 'HTML link extraction only. A title cannot verify fit, deadline, eligibility or a submission route. Zero extracted links can reflect page rendering or link structure.'}
output = root / 'director-capture-readback.json'
output.write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'artifact': str(output), 'notice_links': len(links), 'keyword_hits': sum(link['keyword_hit'] for link in links), 'search_filter_verified': False}))
